info.name: Amazon Cloud WAN Core Networks API
Amazon Cloud WAN List Core Networks

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: The token for the next page of results.

items.docs: Returns a list of owned and shared core networks.

info.name: Amazon Cloud WAN Create a Core Network

items.docs: Creates a core network as part of your global network, and optionally, with a core network policy.

info.name: Amazon Cloud WAN Get a Core Network

params.name: coreNetworkId
params.description: The ID of a core network.

items.docs: Returns information about the LIVE policy for a core network.

info.name: Amazon Cloud WAN Delete a Core Network

params.name: coreNetworkId
params.description: The network ID of the deleted core network.

items.docs: Deletes a core network along with all core network policies. This can only be done if there are no attachments on a core network.
